text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Because I had leftover friendship chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Because I bought way too many cookies for snack time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day, so I thought I might as well give some to that guy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But once I saw her face, I just couldn't...
In the end, I didn't give her anything.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—And that brings us to White Day.
Where are the chocolates...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
“...I kept it because it lasts a long time.
It's not like I'm clinging to lingering regrets or anything.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Then why don't you
just eat the cookies?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that I wanted to give it, okay?
It's just... I decided on my own to "give" it, but
worrying about how it looked was so lame.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been feeling so restless.
If I don't give this to them, it just won't sit right with me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What would you do, Spe-senpai?
You'd totally just scarf it down, right? Right?
That's definitely the right move, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm not really sure, but
if it were me, I'm sure—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —If it were me, I'd hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, isn't this kind of weird?
Giving someone chocolate on White Day even though they didn't give me any on Valentine's...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it matters, but...
after all, you want to hand it over, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure why you came to me for advice, though...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as running because you want to, right?
I do it just because I want to...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Besides, I'm sure whoever receives it
will be super happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's a bit late, no matter the reason!
It shows me that you were thinking of me♪"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-No, it's not like I was worried about it or anything—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it wasn't? But if you couldn't
throw it away or eat it, that must mean...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. As I thought, you really want to give it to them!
If it were me, I'd probably cherish my feelings...♪

text_block_list.name: Daska & Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey...! Um, so...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? They look awkward...
Did things not go well?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Who knows...? If you're curious, let's ask
next time everyone gets together.
